en.t: It is said that Shakyamuni once taught:

units.source_text: 鸟和枭共栖一树，亲如骨肉时，我才圆寂。

en.t: Only when birds and owls live together in the same tree, as close as flesh and blood, will I pass away.

units.source_text: 蛇、鼠和狼都同住一穴，情如手足时，我才涅槃……

en.t: Only when snakes, rats, and wolves all live in the same den, bound together like brothers, will I enter nirvana...

units.source_text: 如今，象和猴是那样融洽呀。”

en.t: And now, the elephant and the monkey are living together in such harmony.
